title: F-Q17: max KeyPackage lifetime 1 year + 1 hour
description: RFC 9420 §7.2: applications MUST define a maximum total lifetime. Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18: longer than OpenMLS's 84-day default, so stock mls-rs KeyPackages (1-year default lifetime) are accepted: MAX_KEY_PACKAGE_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 365 days + 1 hour (margin mirrors the 84d+1h one). Lifetime is checked against both the supplied now and the system clock (OpenMLS; kept by Mark, no fork change).
